current_claim: H-JEPA dynamically grounds visible relocated physical targets requiring active locomotion (init dist >= 0.60m)
caveat: Guaranteed initial waypoint distance >= 0.60m and physical relocation >= 0.75m; eliminates 0m initial distance confound. Locomotion verified (median path 0.488m); performance degrades significantly relative to canonical baseline (p=0.03125).

current_claim: Task identity token selectively binds to and steers toward designated visual object under dual visibility
caveat: Dual-target discrimination is only 10.0% (5/50 pairs), significantly worse than 25% chance (p=0.0133). Inferred angular shift (47.9 deg) reflects dominant additive task bias (Additive MSE 0.0334 vs Selection MSE 0.1357), not geometric object selection.

current_claim: Categorical task token conditioning competes with low-level visual saliency under dual visible targets
caveat: Under conflict where visual target differs from designated semantic token, success drops to 86.7% and agent heads toward canonical position in 63.3% of episodes.

current_claim: Learned micro_ego_head maintains egocentric spatial tracking during temporary visual blackout
comparison: vs Zeroed Ego-Motion (0.7082m) and Oracle Odometry (0.5581m)
caveat: Under zero latent delta (Delta s = 0 during blackout), micro_ego_head outputs constant static bias [0.0129, 0.0014, 0.0001]. Same-trajectory replay proves full memory is equivalent to zeroed ego motion within 3.5mm (TOST p < 0.001). Fixed 0.65/0.35 blending erases memory into black-frame noise (0.35^10 ~ 2.7e-5).

current_claim: Goal persistence under occlusion relies on learned ego-displacement head integrated with handwritten controller vector accumulation
caveat: Offline calibration shows micro_ego_head has 0.027m 1-step MAE but scale factor is only 0.267 on dx and 0.0029 on dtheta; rotation and exponential blending are computed purely by handwritten Python controller code.

current_claim: Grounding head contains a modular, selectively patchable subcircuit for target spatial orientation
caveat: Hidden layer patching achieves 100% directional transfer at both Layer 1 and Layer 2, but top-16 activation corruption causes shift comparable to random 16D ablation, confirming distributed representation across MLP weights rather than a modular subcircuit.

current_claim: Prospective collision head provides no closed-loop collision rate reduction over a disabled head
caveat: Intact, shuffled, and disabled heads yield identical 70% collision rates; empirical soft penalty is not a formal Control Barrier Function; clustered bootstrap AUROC CI is [0.5, 1.0].

current_claim: K=5 macro rollouts beat random candidate selection but do not outperform recursive 1-step micro planning
caveat: Macro beats random candidate selection (p=0.0117), but closed-loop difference vs 1-step micro lookahead is non-significant.

current_claim: Visual encoder preserves global co-rotation but lacks steerable egocentric group-equivariant representations
caveat: Behavioral retention under global arena rotation arises from preserved camera viewpoint, not group-equivariant CNN kernels.
